exposure: Perception of abuse during childbirth (CARE-MQ scores)
cohort: The study included 2,912 women in Spain who had given birth within the last 18 months.
finding: Higher perceived abuse during childbirth, especially inadequate treatment by professionals, is strongly correlated with an increased risk of postpartum PTSD.
mod_finding: Type of birth and emergency cesarean sections were identified as additional risk factors for postpartum PTSD.
